text:
Taylor: Quick silly poll: imaginary tiny office blaze, you can grab exactly one editor on your way out. Which do you grab? Drop a number or short reply. :fire:
Jules: 1) VS Code - extensions + settings sync = carry-on tech.
Priya: 2) Neovim - lightweight and my fingers know it.
Taylor: Poll choices (react with emoji): 1 VS Code, 2 Neovim, 3 Emacs, 4 Sublime, 5 Nano
Jules: reacted :one: - saves all my workspace layouts.
Priya: reacted :two: - config is sacred.
ops-bot: FYI: fire alarm test scheduled after lunch, no actual fires please. :robot_face:
Taylor: Any comedic takes?
Jules: I'd try to grab both my editor and my succulent but priorities, y'know.
Priya: Honorary mention: JetBrains when I'm in a mood.
Taylor: Tally so far: VS Code 1, Neovim 1, Emacs 0, Sublime 0, Nano 0. Neck and neck.
Jules: We should do a follow-up: "which snack to hide in your editor bag" poll.
Priya: Popcorn wins, always.
Taylor: Agreed, next week snack bracket it is. :popcorn:
